## Whole-file contract

Rows r=0..4096 contain id=r; name=null for r%7=0, else32-byte value-NNNN-deterministic-fixture; items=null for r%11=0, else[r,(null if r%5=0 else2*r),3*r]; category=null for r%13=0, else[red,green,blue][r%3]; blob always31-byte blob-NNNN-deterministic-payload. NNNN is decimal r padded to4 digits. Counts are586 null names,373 null lists,11,172 child values with745 null children,316 null categories and zero null/empty blobs. (rust/lance-file/test_data/exact_versions/datagen.rs:37-99; rust/lance-file/test_data/exact_versions/v2_0.lance@bytes:0-706157)

Five batch writes have lengths1024,1024,1024,1024,1. Each writes its out-of-line blobs first, then physical columns0..5. Every page buffer and blob payload is padded separately to64 bytes using0x48, excluded from metadata buffer sizes. The unframed descriptor and following metadata/tables/footer are not padded. Data region[0,619328) consists of312875 page-payload bytes,44245 page-padding bytes,127007 blob-payload bytes and135201 blob-padding bytes. There are1874 page buffers and1324 unused zero bits in child validity tails. (rust/lance-file/test_data/exact_versions/datagen.rs:102-131; rust/lance-file/src/versions/v2_0/writer.rs:222-276; rust/lance-file/src/versions/v2_0/writer.rs:451-506; rust/lance-file/test_data/exact_versions/v2_0.lance@bytes:0-619328)

Schema global0 occupies[619328,619655), column metadata[619655,706005), CMO[706005,706101), GBO[706101,706117), footer[706117,706157). Footer identifies standard V2_0 as(0,3).
